spanish: Encantada de conocerte, me llamo Ana y soy española.
english: Nice to meet you, my name is Ana and I am Spanish.

spanish: Nuestra amistad es muy importante para los dos.
english: Our friendship is very important to both of us.

spanish: Mi hermano es muy guapo y simpático.
english: My brother is very handsome and nice.

spanish: Mi hermana es rubia y tiene los ojos azules.
english: My sister is blond and has blue eyes.

spanish: La chica es muy guapa y simpática.
english: The girl is very good-looking and nice.

spanish: Mi madre tiene el pelo largo y negro.
english: My mother has long black hair.

spanish: Voy al supermercado para comprar comida para casa.
english: I go to the supermarket to buy food for home.

spanish: El coche está delante de nuestra casa.
english: The car is in front of our house.

spanish: Comemos juntos en el comedor todos los días.
english: We eat together in the dining room every day.

spanish: El libro está encima de la mesa.
english: The book is on top of the table.

spanish: Mis zapatos están abajo, cerca de la puerta.
english: My shoes are downstairs, near the door.

spanish: Hoy comemos pollo con arroz y verduras.
english: Today we are eating chicken with rice and vegetables.

spanish: Pongo un tomate en mi ensalada.
english: I put a tomato in my salad.

spanish: Compro un paquete de arroz en el supermercado.
english: I buy a packet of rice at the supermarket.

spanish: Pongo la comida en el carrito del supermercado.
english: I put the food in the supermarket trolley.

spanish: Pago la comida en la caja del supermercado.
english: I pay for the food at the supermarket checkout.

spanish: Hoy es el cumpleaños de mi hermana pequeña.
english: Today is my little sister's birthday.

spanish: Tenemos un pastel de chocolate para la fiesta.
english: We have a chocolate cake for the party.

spanish: Tengo un regalo para mi mejor amigo.
english: I have a present for my best friend.

spanish: Pongo una vela sobre el pastel de cumpleaños.
english: I put a candle on the birthday cake.

spanish: Hay un globo rojo en la habitación.
english: There is a red balloon in the room.

spanish: Escribo las palabras nuevas en mi cuaderno.
english: I write the new words in my notebook.

spanish: La vela está sobre la mesa del comedor.
english: The candle is on the dining room table.

spanish: Mi color favorito es el azul claro.
english: My favourite colour is light blue.

spanish: Quiero una bebida fría con la comida.
english: I want a cold drink with the meal.

spanish: Este mes tengo mucho trabajo en casa.
english: This month I have a lot of work at home.

spanish: En marzo empieza la primavera en mi ciudad.
english: In March, spring begins in my city.

spanish: Mi cumpleaños es en abril de cada año.
english: My birthday is in April every year.

spanish: En junio hace calor y vamos a la playa.
english: In June it is hot and we go to the beach.

spanish: En julio viajo con mi familia a España.
english: In July I travel to Spain with my family.

spanish: En septiembre los niños vuelven a la escuela.
english: In September the children go back to school.

spanish: El viaje a Madrid es muy largo.
english: The trip to Madrid is very long.

spanish: Esta tradición es importante para mi familia.
english: This tradition is important to my family.

spanish: Hay una foto grande en la pared.
english: There is a large photo on the wall.

spanish: Miro el mapa para encontrar la estación.
english: I look at the map to find the station.

spanish: La celebración empieza a las ocho de la noche.
english: The celebration starts at eight in the evening.

spanish: Tengo una sorpresa para mi madre esta noche.
english: I have a surprise for my mother tonight.

spanish: Mi abuelo tiene cincuenta libros en su casa.
english: My grandfather has fifty books in his house.

spanish: ¿Cuándo empieza la clase de español hoy?
english: When does the Spanish class start today?

spanish: Comemos juntos a mediodía todos los domingos.
english: We eat together at noon every Sunday.

spanish: Mi hermano juega al fútbol todos los sábados.
english: My brother plays football every Saturday.

spanish: Me gustan los deportes porque son divertidos.
english: I like sports because they are fun.

spanish: Escucho música española en mi teléfono.
english: I listen to Spanish music on my phone.

spanish: Leo los libros de mi hermana pequeña.
english: I read my little sister's books.

spanish: Quiero comprobar la hora antes de salir.
english: I want to check the time before leaving.

spanish: Tengo un ticket para el tren de Madrid.
english: I have a ticket for the train to Madrid.

spanish: ¿Adónde vas después de la clase de español?
english: Where are you going after the Spanish class?

spanish: ¿Puedes hacerme un favor esta tarde, por favor?
english: Can you do me a favour this afternoon, please?

spanish: Mi hermano toca la guitarra después de cenar.
english: My brother plays the guitar after dinner.

spanish: Mi hermana toca el piano todos los días.
english: My sister plays the piano every day.

spanish: El español es un idioma muy bonito.
english: Spanish is a very beautiful language.

spanish: Escribo la dirección en mi cuaderno.
english: I write the address in my notebook.

spanish: Mi número de teléfono está en este papel.
english: My telephone number is on this piece of paper.

spanish: Necesito información sobre los trenes de mañana.
english: I need information about tomorrow's trains.

spanish: Mi ciudad tiene muchos parques y edificios grandes.
english: My city has many parks and large buildings.

spanish: España es un país de Europa.
english: Spain is a country in Europe.

spanish: El profesor explica la lección con mucha paciencia.
english: The teacher explains the lesson very patiently.

spanish: La profesora habla español en nuestra clase.
english: The teacher speaks Spanish in our class.

spanish: Mi amigo vive cerca de mi casa.
english: My friend lives near my house.

spanish: Hay mucha gente en la plaza hoy.
english: There are many people in the square today.

spanish: Pongo un poco de sal en la sopa.
english: I put a little salt in the soup.

spanish: Necesito tu ayuda con este ejercicio.
english: I need your help with this exercise.

spanish: Bebo jugo de naranja por la mañana.
english: I drink orange juice in the morning.

spanish: Quiero un refresco frío con mi comida.
english: I want a cold soft drink with my meal.

spanish: Quiero ordenar una pizza para cenar.
english: I want to order a pizza for dinner.

spanish: Miro el menú antes de pedir la comida.
english: I look at the menu before ordering the food.

spanish: Leo el mensaje de mi amigo por la mañana.
english: I read my friend's message in the morning.

spanish: Tomamos café en la terraza del restaurante.
english: We have coffee on the restaurant terrace.

spanish: Leo un artículo corto sobre la ciudad.
english: I read a short article about the city.

spanish: Leo una novela española en mi habitación.
english: I read a Spanish novel in my room.

spanish: El gato duerme tranquilamente en el sofá.
english: The cat sleeps peacefully on the sofa.

spanish: Mi gato duerme siempre en el sofá.
english: My cat always sleeps on the sofa.

spanish: No entiendo la diferencia entre estas dos palabras.
english: I do not understand the difference between these two words.

spanish: Este es un buen momento para descansar.
english: This is a good moment to rest.

spanish: Mi teléfono está encima de la mesa.
english: My telephone is on top of the table.

spanish: Tengo una llamada de mi madre esta tarde.
english: I have a call from my mother this afternoon.

spanish: Hay mucho ruido en la calle esta noche.
english: There is a lot of noise in the street tonight.

spanish: La estación está cerca de mi casa.
english: The station is near my house.

spanish: El precio de esta camiseta es muy alto.
english: The price of this T-shirt is very high.

spanish: Hay un cuadro bonito en la pared.
english: There is a beautiful painting on the wall.

spanish: Pongo las verduras en una bolsa grande.
english: I put the vegetables in a large bag.

spanish: Mi oficina está en un edificio grande.
english: My office is in a large building.

spanish: La torre es muy alta y antigua.
english: The tower is very tall and old.

spanish: Cruzamos el puente para llegar al centro.
english: We cross the bridge to get to the centre.

spanish: Esta cosa pequeña está sobre la mesa.
english: This small thing is on the table.

spanish: La verdad es que estoy muy cansado.
english: The truth is that I am very tired.

spanish: La fiesta es genial y todos están contentos.
english: The party is great and everyone is happy.

spanish: Quiero llevarme esta camiseta porque me gusta mucho.
english: I want to take this T-shirt because I really like it.

spanish: Compro un recuerdo pequeño para mi familia.
english: I buy a small souvenir for my family.

spanish: Compro fruta fresca en el puesto del mercado.
english: I buy fresh fruit at the market stall.

spanish: Esta camisa es de seda y muy suave.
english: This shirt is made of silk and is very soft.

spanish: Llevo un sombrero cuando hace mucho sol.
english: I wear a hat when it is very sunny.

spanish: La ubicación del hotel es muy buena.
english: The location of the hotel is very good.

spanish: Espero en el semáforo antes de cruzar la calle.
english: I wait at the traffic light before crossing the street.

spanish: Me duele la cabeza después de trabajar mucho.
english: My head hurts after working a lot.

spanish: Me duele la garganta y bebo agua caliente.
english: My throat hurts and I drink hot water.

spanish: Me duele la espalda después de estar sentado.
english: My back hurts after sitting down.

spanish: Me duele el estómago después de comer mucho.
english: My stomach hurts after eating a lot.

spanish: Me duele el pie después de caminar mucho.
english: My foot hurts after walking a lot.

spanish: Mis ojos están cansados después de leer mucho.
english: My eyes are tired after reading a lot.
